summary: Axon Enterprise filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for $1,000,000,000 of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due September 15, 2031, under an existing shelf (File 333-277559). The notes bear no regular interest, are non-accreting, and carry a $652.06 initial conversion price (1.5336 shares per $1,000). Conversion triggers include a 130% stock-price condition, trading-price condition, redemption call, or specified corporate events; hard conversion opens June 15, 2031. Optional redemption begins September 20, 2029, plus cleanup redemption under 10% outstanding. Terms such as price, coupon and use of proceeds remain incomplete pending pricing; watch final pricing and hedge-driven delta flow into AXON shares at launch.
